note: R-011/R-012 held-out discovery eval pairs. Corpus is built by buildDatabaseDiscoveryCorpus() in database-discovery-eval.ts (six databases; customer-feedback/customer-research share the 'insights' vocabulary word on purpose, engineering-tasks/bug-tracker share 'backlog' on purpose and 'team' in their common purpose phrasing, to produce genuine score ties). Every non-ambiguous pair resolves to exactly one candidate (the runner-up scores 0 and is filtered out of the catalog response entirely); every ambiguous pair's top two candidates tie exactly at 145 or 70, verified against the real DatabaseDataPlane#catalog scorer (see debug-discovery.ts run in the implementing session), so DEFAULT_AMBIGUITY_MARGIN=10 cleanly separates the two classes without being tuned to either split. Deliberately avoids 'customer'/'engineering' as shared words: those substrings also appear inside the databases' own key/name/source fields, which breaks the intended tie (verified empirically, not assumed).
